headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: GAS (16)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Canadian Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 3.9s ahead of Lando Norris, with George Russell completing the podium.
Esteban Ocon made the biggest climb, from P18 to P10.
Yuki Tsunoda had a day to forget, dropping from P8 to P14.
The race was neutralised by 2 safety cars.
The stewards penalised RIC (5 second time penalty).
There were 42 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 56 points over Charles Leclerc.
